results.title: relative link quarantined; absolute claims
results.threat: Field isolation: the bad entry dies, the good one claims.

results.title: javascript: link -> bad-scheme quarantine
results.threat: Non-http(s) schemes are never navigation candidates.

results.title: item without link -> missing-link quarantine
results.threat: An entry with no identity signal is quarantined, not attached to a neighbor.

results.title: atom link without href -> missing-link quarantine
results.threat: An href-less link element yields no candidate.

results.title: atom relative href -> relative-link quarantine
results.threat: Relative hrefs quarantine exactly like relative RSS links.

results.title: credential-bearing link -> quarantined with redaction
results.threat: Secret-shaped: quarantined, detail redacted per the credentials rule.

results.title: uppercase tags not recognized (XML case-sensitivity)
results.threat: Strict per XML: <ITEM> is not an entry; nothing claims.

assertions.name: invariant:claims-grounded
assertions.detail: zero claims (legitimate empty or failure path)

results.title: link with whitespace -> trimmed, claimed
results.threat: Whitespace is normalized, never part of the URL.

results.title: fragment kept verbatim (documented)
results.threat: The link claims as written; no fragment stripping is guessed.

results.title: bad pubDate quarantined; link still claims
results.threat: Date validation failure does not poison the link discovery.

results.title: RFC822 pubDate variants accepted
results.threat: Day-name and numeric-zone forms validate.

results.title: atom RFC3339 updated accepted
results.threat: Full datetime validates for atom.

results.title: bad atom updated quarantined
results.threat: Malformed updated is quarantined per-entry.

results.title: future pubDate accepted with note
results.threat: Unusual but legal; the lab does not police the calendar.

results.title: duplicate guid, identical content -> dedupe, one claim
results.threat: Same guid and same content is one entry observed twice.

results.title: duplicate guid, different title -> unresolved guid conflict
results.threat: Same identity, different content: no canonical version is picked.

results.title: two differing atom alternates -> unresolved
results.threat: No preferred alternate is guessed.

assertions.name: invariant:claims-grounded
assertions.detail: zero claims (legitimate empty or failure path)

results.title: guid isPermaLink=false -> opaque, never a link claim
results.threat: An opaque guid is identity, not navigation.

results.title: guid equal to link -> single claim, no double count
results.threat: The default permaLink guid duplicates the link; one claim results.

results.title: atom id as urn:uuid -> opaque, link still claims
results.threat: Atom ids are opaque by spec; the href carries the claim.

results.title: rss guid differing from link -> guid is evidence only
results.threat: Only the link claims; the guid never becomes an entry_link.

results.title: content:encoded with script -> script stripped, link claims
results.threat: Embedded scripts never survive content extraction.

results.title: CDATA description extracted literally
results.threat: CDATA is literal text through the pipeline.

results.title: comment with fake items ignored
results.threat: Comments never become entries.

results.title: enclosure is evidence only
results.threat: Enclosure URLs are counted, never claimed as entry links.

results.title: title with inner HTML tags -> stripped
results.threat: Titles are text; markup inside is removed, not rendered.

results.title: atom content type=html -> tags stripped
results.threat: HTML content is flattened to text.

results.title: atom content with src -> external, never fetched
results.threat: External content references are noted, not dereferenced.

results.title: description-only item (no title) -> link still claims
results.threat: A missing title does not block link discovery.

results.title: 10KB title -> field truncation flagged
results.threat: Over the 4KiB text cap: truncation flagged, entry still processed.

results.title: nested item -> nested-entry quarantine
results.threat: Nesting is not a second entry.

results.title: itunes extension ignored
results.threat: Extension namespaces are not parsed; core entries claim.

results.title: channel image extras ignored
results.threat: Non-entry channel children are not entries.

results.title: two concatenated feeds -> first root parsed, tail ignored
results.threat: The lab parses one document; trailing roots are not re-entered (documented).

results.title: entity-encoded link decoded once
results.threat: & decodes to & in the claimed URL.

results.title: 10001 items -> entry cap fires, first 10k claim
results.threat: Over the 10k cap: truncation flagged, head entries honored.

results.title: 60000 items -> cap holds at 10k
results.threat: Well under the 5MB doc cap but over the entry cap: truncation, not failure.

results.title: dc:creator extension ignored
results.threat: Dublin-core extensions are not parsed; core entries claim.

results.title: multiple categories ignored
results.threat: Category children are not entries and never claim.

results.title: feed kitchen sink -> exact claim set
results.threat: Valid, relative, bad-date, duplicate-guid, CDATA, comment-fake, and bad-scheme items at once.
